title: benkara malabarica
intro: Benkara malabarica, commonly known as Malabar nut, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, malaria, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Benkara malabarica include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight against bacterial and fungal infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Benkara malabarica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
